switch_schedule.name: Switch Schedule
switch_schedule.description: Activate a schedule in the selected home. Names are validated against its current schedules.

home_id.name: Home ID
home_id.description: Target a loaded home by its Intuis home ID. Without a target, uses the first loaded home (and warns if several are loaded).

schedule_name.name: Schedule Name
schedule_name.description: Exact schedule name in the selected home.

refresh_schedules.name: Refresh Schedules
refresh_schedules.description: Fetch the current schedules for the selected home, or all homes if omitted.

home_id.name: Home ID
home_id.description: Target a loaded home by its Intuis home ID. Without a target, applies to all loaded homes.

set_schedule_slot.name: Set Schedule Slot
set_schedule_slot.description: Replace a complete interval in the selected home’s active weekly schedule. Supply start_day and end_day, or the legacy day field for both.

home_id.name: Home ID
home_id.description: Target a loaded home by its Intuis home ID. Without a target, uses the first loaded home (and warns if several are loaded).

start_day.name: Start Day
start_day.description: Start day: 0=Monday, 6=Sunday. Required unless day is supplied.

end_day.name: End Day
end_day.description: End day: 0=Monday, 6=Sunday. Required unless day is supplied.

day.name: Day (Legacy)
day.description: Compatibility alias supplying both days when start_day/end_day are omitted.

start_time.name: Start Time
start_time.description: Start time HH:MM; seconds must be zero.

end_time.name: End Time
end_time.description: End time HH:MM. Same-day 00:00 means the following midnight.

zone_name.name: Zone Name
zone_name.description: Zone name in the active schedule of the selected home.

schedule_name.name: Schedule Name
schedule_name.description: Optional current name; defaults to active schedule.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: Optional stable ID; must match schedule_name if both are supplied.

set_zone_temperature.name: Set Zone Temperature
set_zone_temperature.description: Set a room’s temperature in a schedule zone, preserving half degrees.

home_id.name: Home ID
home_id.description: Target a loaded home by its Intuis home ID. Without a target, uses the first loaded home (and warns if several are loaded).

schedule_name.name: Schedule Name
schedule_name.description: Exact schedule name in the selected home.

room_name.name: Room Name
room_name.description: Room name in that zone and home.

import_energy_history.name: Import Energy History
import_energy_history.description: Import complete local days with validated coverage (requires live recorder statistics), or closed hours into separate external hourly statistics. Failures preserve history.

home_id.name: Home ID
home_id.description: Target a loaded home by its Intuis home ID. Without a target, applies to all loaded homes.

days.name: Days to Import
days.description: Whole number of closed days to import (1–730).

room_name.name: Room (Optional)
room_name.description: Leave empty for all rooms. Without home_id, only homes containing this room are imported.

granularity.name: Granularity
granularity.description: daily (default, also 1day) replaces the daily sensor history; hourly (also 1hour) imports closed hours into the separate external hourly statistics.

sync_schedule.name: Sync Schedule
sync_schedule.description: Replace a complete weekly timetable and/or away/frost temperatures after validation. Defaults to the active schedule.

schedule_name.name: Schedule Name
schedule_name.description: Current schedule name; must match ID if supplied.

timetable.name: Timetable
timetable.description: List or JSON of unique m_offset/zone_id transitions (maximum 512).

user.title: Connect Your Account
user.description: Enter your Netatmo/Intuis credentials to connect your heating system.

select_home.title: Select Home
select_home.description:
Your account has multiple homes. Select which one to configure.

You can add additional homes by setting up the integration again.

indefinite.title: Override Behavior
indefinite.description: Choose what happens when temperature overrides expire.

data_description.indefinite_mode:
**ON**: Temperature changes stay active until you change them again (auto-renewed before the 12-hour hardware limit).

**OFF**: Overrides expire after their set duration and return to schedule.

overrides.title: Temperature & Duration Settings
overrides.description:
Set preset temperatures and how long overrides last.

*Note: The 12-hour maximum for Manual and Boost is a hardware limit.*

data_description.away_temp: Temperature when Away mode is active (e.g., on vacation).
data_description.manual_duration: How long manual temperature changes last.
data_description.away_duration: How long Away mode stays active.
data_description.boost_duration: How long Boost mode stays active.

energy.title: Energy Monitoring
energy.description: Configure how energy usage is tracked.

data_description.energy_scale: How often to update energy consumption data.
data_description.energy_reset_hour: Hour when daily energy counters reset (0-23). Default is 2 AM to ensure previous day's data is finalized.

history_import.title: Historical Energy Import
history_import.description:
Import historical energy consumption data from Intuis cloud.

This will populate the Energy Dashboard with past data.

data_description.import_history: Enable to import historical energy data after setup completes.
data_description.import_history_days: How far back to import energy data. Longer periods take more time due to API rate limits (~2 seconds per day).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Intuis Account
reauth_confirm.description: Session expired for {username}. Please enter your password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Intuis service. Please check your internet connection.
error.home_not_found: Selected home not found. Please try again.

abort.all_homes_configured: All homes from this account are already configured.

energy.title: Energy Monitoring
energy.description: Configure how energy usage is tracked.

data_description.energy_scale: How often to update energy consumption data.
data_description.energy_reset_hour: Hour when daily energy counters reset (0-23). Default is 2 AM to ensure previous day's data is finalized.
data_description.hourly_statistics: Opt-in: import closed hours into separate external statistics per room and for the home. Daily energy sensors are unchanged.
data_description.hourly_statistics_interval: How often to re-read the last 48 closed hours (catch-up up to 7 days after an interruption).

cost.title: Energy Costs
cost.description: Opt-in: hourly cost statistics in {currency}, computed from confirmed hourly energy. Requires hourly statistics. A missing price is never guessed.

data_description.cost_statistics: Enable cost statistics per room and for the home. Disabling keeps existing statistics.
data_description.cost_price_mode: Fixed price, or a sensor whose recorded history gives the price at the start of each hour.
data_description.cost_fixed_price: Price per kWh in {currency}; negative values are allowed. Applies only to the hours it is used for.
data_description.cost_price_entity: Sensor reporting {currency}/kWh. Hours without a valid recorded price are refused.

rate_limit.title: API Rate Limiting
rate_limit.description:
Configure how the integration handles API rate limits (429 errors).

These settings help prevent being blocked by the Intuis API during heavy usage.

data_description.rate_limit_delay: How long to wait before retrying after a rate limit error.
data_description.circuit_breaker_threshold: Number of consecutive rate limit errors before pausing all requests.
data_description.max_update_interval: Maximum polling interval when rate limited. Normally polls every 2 minutes.

error.cost_requires_hourly: Enable hourly statistics first: costs are computed from confirmed hourly energy.
error.price_entity_unit: The price sensor must report the price per kWh in the Home Assistant currency.
